overall_goal: Clean up the kitchen, prepare the plant-based burger, and gather ingredients and equipment for cooking.

goals.description: Dispose of food waste and put the bin away.
goals.rationale: The person throws peel into the food waste bin, closes it, and stores it in the cupboard.

goals.description: Clean and put away the coffee equipment.
goals.rationale: The person empties the used coffee grounds into the bin, washes the V60 filter and stand, and places them on the drying rack.
The person uses soap and water to wash their hands, then dries them with a cloth.
The person picks up the scale and stores it in the bottom cupboard.

goals.description: Unpack the plant-based burger and dispose of the sleeves.
goals.rationale: The person removes the burger from its packaging and throws the plastic and cardboard sleeves into the appropriate bins.

goals.description: Transfer the plant-based burger to the chopping board.
goals.rationale: The person moves the burger from its packaging onto the chopping board to prepare for cutting.

goals.description: Wash and recycle the plastic packaging.
goals.rationale: The person washes the empty plastic packaging with a sponge and throws it into the plastic recycling bin.

goals.description: Cut the plant-based burger into strips.
goals.rationale: The person clears space on the counter, positions the chopping board, and slices the burger into strips.

goals.description: Wash and dry hands after handling raw food.
goals.rationale: The person rinses their hands under the tap to remove raw food residue and dries them with a cloth.

goals.description: Retrieve a frying pan and place it on the hob.
goals.rationale: The person takes a large frying pan from the cupboard, rearranging other pans, and sets it on the stove.

goals.description: Retrieve the recipe kit and seasoning.
goals.rationale: The person searches for the correct recipe kit box, opens it, and takes out the stroganoff seasoning and a teaspoon.

goals.description: Prepare a plate with stroganoff seasoning.
goals.rationale: The person gets a plate from the cupboard, pours the seasoning onto it, and shakes the plate to spread the seasoning evenly.

goals.description: Transfer the plant-based burger strips to the seasoned plate.
goals.rationale: The person moves the chopping board and transfers the cut burger strips onto the plate to coat them in seasoning.
